common.installIosBody: On iPhone or iPad: tap Share and then Add to Home Screen.
common.installDesktopBody:
In Chrome or Edge: menu ⋮ → Install Inspetor BudGanja… (or the ⊕ / computer icon in the address bar).

In the install window, check Create desktop shortcut so the icon appears on your desktop.
common.installAndroidBody:
In Chrome: tap ⋮ (top corner) and choose Install app or Add to Home screen.

If the option does not appear: remove the old icon (if any), open the site in Chrome, wait a few seconds, and try again with this button.

Tip: use the site’s secure link (https) and keep the page open while installing.
common.installAlreadyBody:
BudGanja is already running as an app on this device. Look for the icon on your home screen or in the app drawer.

If the old icon is broken, remove it and install again from the site menu.
common.cookieConsentText: We use Google Analytics (GA4) to understand how the site is used. Advertising cookies stay off. You can accept or decline — see the privacy policy for details

inspections.title: Inspections
inspections.subtitle: Technical reports with a verifiable method — legacy, people, channels, courses, articles, medicinal plants, fruits, harmful products (casein, gluten, sugar…), words, outreach, arts and equipment.
inspections.sectionPeopleDesc: Documentary tributes to reference figures — life, credit due, and links to the inspected ecosystem.
inspections.sectionPeopleHistoryDesc: Figures whose research or creative method — travel, ethnography, peoples, plants or language — informs the lab. Distinct from cannabis Legacy; each sheet links to plants and/or the Words series.
inspections.sectionOutreachDesc: Public health and cannabinoid communication outside the UNIFESP–MovReCam–CEBRID axis — channel, texts and limits, without equating to academic Legacy.
inspections.sectionArtsDesc: Films, series, music, visual arts and cultural works linked to plants, language or the inspected ecosystem — suggestion queue below; published reports appear as cards. Distinct from Channels (YouTube) and People (biography).
inspections.sectionChannelsDesc: Editorial and technical review of public channels — catalog, thematic focus and grower utility.
inspections.sectionCoursesDesc: Analysis of extension and training programs — hours, access, syllabus and practical value.
inspections.sectionArticlesDesc: Editorial audit of peer-reviewed scientific papers — design, findings, limits and educational value.
inspections.sectionPlantsDesc: Educational reports on species from the medicinal plants catalog — profile, traditional uses, cautions and UNIFESP links.
inspections.sectionFruitsDesc: Fruit inspections from the catalog — water, pulp and edible parts — distinct from generic medicinal plants and from industrial risk derivatives.
inspections.sectionDerivativesDesc: Industrial proteins and matrices linked to bodily harm — casein, gluten, free sugars and other derivatives — without demonizing the source; focus on industrial diversion and dose.
inspections.sectionWordsDesc: Origin, journey and historical transformation of vocabulary — including a map of double meanings that harm originality; published sheets as cards and the suggestion queue below.
inspections.plantsDropDesc: Species profiles and reports — tap to expand the list.
inspections.sectionSuggestionsDesc: Lab editorial queue — ideas and upcoming reports, kept separate from published inspections. When a report ships, the suggestion is marked done automatically.
